interface.longDescription: Remove the background from an attached image and download a transparent PNG, or request a plain white or black replacement. Compare the original and result inline. Fine edges, hair and transparent materials may need review. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Remove this photo’s background and give me a transparent PNG.
Put this subject on a plain white background.

positive.expected_behavior: background=transparent; result is a PNG with alpha and source comparison.
